newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega accepts Bandai request to cancel merger plan.
newsitem.headline: Sega accepts Bandai request to cancel merger plan.

text.p: Sega Enterprises Ltd said on Tuesday that it had accepted Bandai Co Ltd's request to cancel a planned merger.
However, Sega said it had accepted Bandai's alternative offer of a business tie-up.
A Sega spokeswoman said that the company would hold a news conference at 9 p.m. (1200 GMT) to explain the company's decision.
"Bandai requested cancellation of the (planned) merger and offered a business alliance instead, and we accepted," the spokeswoman said.
At the beginning of this year, Bandai and Sega announced that they would merge on October 1.
Japanese media reports recently speculated that the merger could be delayed due to strong opposition from mid-level managers at Bandai.
Bandai said on Monday that it expected its board to approve at a meeting on May 28 the planned merger with Sega, withdrawing an earlier plan to postpone approval until July.
Bandai plans to hold a news conference on the Sega merger plans at 10 p.m. (1300 GMT), Bandai said in a statement. It gave no further details.
Bandai's business has recently been boosted by the popularity of its "Tamagotchi" electronic pet toy.
